definitions.explanation: A particularly favorable moment or opportunity to do something. Often used in formal or written contexts to describe a window of opportunity that should not be missed.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{好機|こうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}して→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: We must not let this opportunity slip away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{円安|えんやす}→円安：04854_enyasu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{輸出|ゆしゅつ}→輸出：02094_yushutsu⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{好機|こうき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: A weak yen presents an opportunity for export companies to expand into overseas markets.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {好機|こうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}す→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧: to miss an opportunity
- {好機|こうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捉|とら}える→捉える：12795_toraeru⟧: to seize an opportunity
- {好機|こうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{到来|とうらい}→到来：11788_tourai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: an opportunity arrives
- {好機|こうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かす: to make the most of an opportunity
- ⟦{絶好|ぜっこう}→絶好：13873_zekkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{好機|こうき}: a perfect opportunity

SIMILAR WORDS:
{好機|こうき} vs ⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧: ⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧ is the general word for "opportunity" or "chance" (neutral). {好機|こうき} specifically emphasizes that the opportunity is favorable and should be acted upon — closer to English "golden opportunity." {好機|こうき} is also more formal and literary.
